A '''breadroot patty''' was an [[Foodstuff/Legends|edible]], white-[[Color/Legends|colored]] patty made from [[breadroot]]. The [[Kragget/Legends|Kragget]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="O66" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> served breadroot patties to its customers.<ref name="O66" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Mij Gilamar]] ordered a breadroot patty with his breakfast at the Kragget. Gilamar used the patty to soak up the [[Werris egg|egg yolk]] and [[Roba/Legends|roba]] meat remains that had been left on his plate after eating the rest of his breakfast, before finishing the patty as well.<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The breadroot patty first appeared in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[September 16]], [[2008]].
